brief: 100+ open-source LLM app templates, accelerating AI app development
Breakout timing: Q2 2023, as LLM adoption surges
Also consider: ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search for AI-driven recruitment

items.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.one_liner: Curated collection of 100+ open-source LLM app templates
items.pain_point: Developers waste weeks rebuilding common LLM patterns; solo devs and startups need fast deploy paths
app_ideas: One-click deploy marketplace for these templates with built-in auth, billing, and hosting
No-code agent builder letting non-devs visually chain these skills into workflows
Vertical agent套装 for specific niches (legal research, sales outreach) with opinionated defaults
items.monetization: Freemium with paid hosting + B2B enterprise add-ons (sso, analytics, rate limits)
items.why_now: LLM app dev is exploding but most devs still build from scratch; this repo shows massive demand for reusable patterns
